headline: Lula’s Victory in Brazil Is a Defeat for Trumpism
summary: Opinion: in Brazil, Lula beat far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro on Oct. 25 to take a record fourth presidential term, a result the writer reads as a setback for Trump-style politics.

headline: Who Are the Houthis and Why Are They Attacking Saudi Arabia’s Airports?
summary: Explainer on Yemen's Houthi rebels as they step up attacks on Saudi airports and energy targets, including a Riyadh airport strike that killed 13 and delayed an EU-Gulf summit.

headline: What Early Voting Data Is Showing About the Midterm Elections
summary: Nearly 33 million Americans have already voted before the Nov. 3 midterms; registered Democrats make up more of the early ballots so far, but Republicans usually catch up on Election Day.

headline: What Trump’s Waiver of New Russia Sanctions Means for Ukraine
summary: Trump signed an executive order waiving many penalties under a law sanctioning Russia and Iran, angering lawmakers in both parties; the piece weighs what the move means for Ukraine.

headline: The Rise of Electrostates Could Redraw The Global Economy
summary: A scorecard of 16 economies finds the switch to electric power uneven: in most countries policy is moving faster than real-world rollout, which could reshape who leads the global economy.

headline: Trump Keeps Promising Cash on the Campaign Trail
summary: On the midterm trail Trump keeps promising Americans direct payments, including a $5,000 dividend TIME estimates would cost about $1.2 trillion, while earlier promised checks never arrived.
